programs.fallbackBlurb: Standardised training delivered by Mwasalat instructors.

busOperations.name: Saeed Al-Habsi
busOperations.quote: I could finish the defensive driving module between shifts. No more scheduling around a fixed classroom seat — the content was there when I was.

passengerSafety.name: Fatma Al-Balushi
passengerSafety.quote: The live sessions on emergency response felt like real classroom training, just from my depot. I asked questions and got answers on the spot.

fleetMaintenance.name: Yousuf Al-Rawahi
fleetMaintenance.quote: Every technician now works from the exact same maintenance checklist. No more picking up different habits depending on who trained you.

customerService.name: Mariam Al-Hinai
customerService.quote: The certificate at the end actually means something — my supervisor could see I'd completed the same standard as everyone else in the department.

routePlanning.name: Khalid Al-Farsi
routePlanning.quote: Route planning used to be tribal knowledge passed around informally. Having it as a proper course made onboarding new planners so much faster.

about.title: Mwasalat Learning Platform
about.body: Mwasalat Learning Platform delivers standardised, role-based training across every department of Mwasalat — from defensive driving and passenger safety to fleet maintenance and customer service. Every program follows a single quality standard, combining self-paced lessons, classroom sessions, and live virtual classes so anyone, staff or public, can build the skills that keep Oman moving safely.
